key_decisions: The crop is DERIVED per run, not a constant: MpiMaskSquareBbox measures the drawn bbox (S) and the user's box (B), MpiMath feeds context_from_mask_extend_factor. 4.267 = 1024/240 lands the scribble at ~240px after the crop node's own 1024x1024 normalise - the WIDEST crop still above the measured ~200px anchor threshold.

ColorMatch (KJNodes, mkl, strength 1, ref = the original crop) sits between the Klein decode and the stitch. It exists because Klein RESTORES a graded photo: on Fabio's vintage plate the returned patch came back de-faded (+9.5/+5.5/+2.6 RGB) with a 3.60 top-edge luma step against the photo's own 0.39. Fixed to -0.20 and confirmed by him.
9B ONLY, and it is correctness not preference: under style load 4B left the user's own drawn ink in the output. No LoRA rack and no style control - style rides in the user's own words.
Op version 1.0 -> 1.1 because two params were removed. Nothing in the app reads latestVersion; only the registry mirror check does.
The flow doc is now on the 200-line EXEMPTION list in docs/README.md (227 lines) rather than being cut - nearly every line is a measured number or a trap.
constraints: safe_math (MpiMath) whitelists math.* ONLY. max() is refused, caught, and returned as 0.0 SILENTLY - which would collapse the crop onto the box with no error anywhere. The floor is a nested conditional expression on purpose. Do not 'tidy' it.
Every MpiLoadImageFromPath reports a preview into /history outputs, so imgs[0] is the INPUT PHOTO. Read node 146 by id or a verification will read 'the flow changed nothing' when the flow is fine.

Seam severity tracks the PLATE'S GRADE, not background uniformity. Every plate an agent reaches for is a modern-looking render where the model's default look already agrees with the photo, so the seam measures ~2/255 and reads as solved. Test a vintage/graded plate before believing it.
Context is NOT the lever for that seam - Fabio tried a bigger box and it changed nothing. The model is not missing reference, it is correcting the photo.
